changelog:
* Feat: Serve the Apple Pay domain verification file from the plugin when the PayPlug account has Apple Pay, for sites at the root of their domain, with nothing to upload, plus a status block with a Resync button in the Apple Pay settings and the wp payplug apple-pay resync command
* Fix: Hide cards saved in euro at checkout when the shop currency is not EUR, as they can only be charged in EUR
* Fix: Remove debug console logs from the integrated payment form and show an error message when the payment cannot be created
* Fix: Show the payment failure reason instead of a generic error and clear the card fields when an integrated payment fails on the checkout block
* Fix: The "Payment methods" tab is now always shown in My Account, whatever the cart total (empty, below the minimum or above the maximum of the card payment)
* Fix: After paying with UHF and 3D Secure with "Save my credit card" ticked, the card is now saved and offered in My account > Payment methods and at the next checkout
